verdict.rationale: Sandboxed execution is well documented: remote sandboxes via Modal, Blaxel, E2B or Docker, plus a rebuilt, more secure LocalPythonExecutor. A Python-import allowlist (`additional_authorized_imports`) is documented, and a community hands-on report confirms it was enforced when matplotlib was blocked. Restricting tools, however, appears limited to choosing which tools to pass to the agent, with no documented per-tool permission model. Missing for 10: fine-grained per-tool permissions (scopes, approvals, argument-level policies), and independent corroboration of the sandbox integrations.
